LESSON: PRONUNCIATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Cultural Activities Suggested vocabulary wedding, dance, party, marry, songs, po
Topic 13.1: Pronunciation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Cultural Activities Suggested vocabulary wedding, dance, party, marry, songs, po in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we listen attentively when other people are talking?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

A. identify words with the target letter- sound combinations in oral texts,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

• Self-efficacy-as learner masters the skill of listening attentively and correct pronunciation.

• Communication and Collaboration - through pair and group work.
